description: a file or directory fs creates gets the mode asked for (writeFile, appendFile, open, FileHandle, createWriteStream, mkdir, recursive mkdir, mkdtemp's 0700) less process.umask(), and an existing one keeps its own; copyFile gives the copy the source's mode; process.umask parses as Node does. The modes are set with chmod, so the shim side needs slicc-kernel 1.86.0
